commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
LA="$HOME/local-agent"
EXPECTED="334a6c373b179061dd8cb544743b26fae34c4e50"
for i in $(seq 1 18); do
  HEAD=$(git -C "$LA" rev-parse HEAD)
  if [ "$HEAD" = "$EXPECTED" ]; then break; fi
  sleep 5
done
HEAD=$(git -C "$LA" rev-parse HEAD)
echo "PRODUCTION_HEAD=$HEAD"
echo "PRODUCTION_BRANCH=$(git -C "$LA" branch --show-current)"
echo "PRODUCTION_DIRTY=$(git -C "$LA" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
p=pathlib.Path.home()/"local-agent/chat_bridge/manifest.json"
print("CHAT_BRIDGE_VERSION=" + json.loads(p.read_text())["version"])
PY
test "$HEAD" = "$EXPECTED"
